overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Bellevue 3-Person Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for optimal relaxation and health benefits, this sauna features 7 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels strategically placed to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood, it includes a chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized spa experience. Ideal for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, the Bellevue sauna combines luxury and functionality with easy clasp-together assembly.
